title: 法拉利與精密汽車製造
summary: 以公開工廠案例理解車身、動力、底盤、塗裝與品質追溯；所有組裝動作以虛擬模型呈現。
summaryEn: Use public factory examples to study body, powertrain, chassis, finishing and quality traceability through virtual assembly.
scope: 公開原理的分層工程教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務，並非原廠配方、施工圖或操作許可。
scopeEn: A layered course in public engineering principles. Steps are verifiable learning tasks, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, or operating authorization.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「法拉利與精密汽車製造」的「定義車輛使用情境」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出儲能、驅動、熱路徑、感測與停止的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「車輛台架：續航與停止」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓車模的負載、能源、時間與停止位置紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Define vehicle use” in “Ferrari and Precision Automotive Manufacturing”. Draw the storage, drive, thermal path, sensing and stopping boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Vehicle Bench: Endurance and Stopping” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for load, energy, timing and stopping-position records from an isolated low-voltage model, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains define vehicle use?
options: 性能、舒適、排放與成本形成互相牽制的需求。
車身、底盤及動力系統的介面決定整車整合。
零件批號與裝配紀錄可定位受影響車輛。
optionsEn: Performance, comfort, emissions and cost create interacting requirements.
Body, chassis and powertrain interfaces determine vehicle integration.
Part lots and assembly records identify affected vehicles.
